changeSet.author: claude (P4-04)
changeSet.comment: Going private hides a listing instead of deleting it (decided 2026-09-27). The hidden row keeps its source_updated_at, so an older dictionary.visibility.public or a snapshot read before the flip compares as stale and cannot re-list a dictionary its owner just made private. Existing rows are all currently public listings, hence DEFAULT true. Browse queries (P4-06) must filter on is_listed = true.
